title: Trump Says US Has ‘Come to a Deal With Canada’
summary: President Donald Trump declared on Wednesday that the US has reached an agreement with Canada on trade, saying that Canadian representatives “gave us the points we had to have.” Trump spoke with Bloomberg’s Tyler Kendall at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stripe Agrees to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter; No Terms Disclosed
summary: Stripe Inc. has agreed to buy OpenRouter Inc., an artificial intelligence startup that helps developers access and switch between AI models. No terms were disclosed.
